scope: Recover bracket-delimited pasted math without changing authored source, code, standard TeX, source positions or Undo.
Terminal base font 16px; web Reader base font 22px, both scaled by the existing per-tab zoom.
Terminal Ctrl+F/Ctrl+Shift+F search with scrollback, wrapped text, counts, IME, next/previous and Escape; no opener button.
Floating native Markdown find panel without reserved full-width strip or preview resizing; source transitions do not steal focus.
Web Reader Ctrl+A and menu Select All select only the active article; native pages, find/address fields and terminal readline retain their input ownership.
